domains.summary: Availability of various data sources for review by the team.

domains.name: Case ID
domains.summary: Unique identifier for each case, not linking to other tables.

domains.name: Cultural Issues
domains.summary: Beliefs and cultural barriers related to pregnancy and health.

domains.name: Document Quality
domains.summary: Inconsistent or unclear information in documents, missing data, lack of doll re-enactment, death scene investigation, and other document issues.

domains.name: Child Welfare
domains.summary: CPS referrals, current and historical abuse/neglect involving the infant and family members.

domains.name: Environmental Factors
domains.summary: Substandard housing, misuse of apnea monitors, improper sleep positions, breastfeeding issues, car seat use, formula preparation problems, lack of supervision, objects in sleep environment, overcrowding, overheating, second-hand smoke exposure, unsafe neighborhood, and other environmental risks.

domains.name: Family Circumstances
domains.summary: Failed contraception, unintended pregnancy, lack of knowledge about birth control methods, no birth control use, family transitions such as divorce or frequent moves, living in shelters, and other family issues.

domains.name: Health History
domains.summary: Alcohol history, birth injuries, congenital anomalies, developmental delays, low birth weight conditions, feeding problems, infections, intrauterine growth restriction, prematurity, prenatal drug use, respiratory distress syndrome, and other health issues.
